title: Protein Bar
description: Chewy store-style protein bars made with fiber syrup, peanut butter and casein — freezer-stable for up to 3 months.
steps: Microwave fiber syrup in a microwave-safe bowl for 15 seconds on medium.
Add peanut butter; stir until melted.
Add half the casein; mix. Add remaining casein and oats; knead into a smooth dough. Add a splash of milk if too dry.
Line a container (16×12cm / 6×5in) with parchment paper. Add dough; flatten evenly. Top with granola and a pinch of salt.
Rest 2 hours. Cut into 5 bars. Wrap in plastic foil; freeze up to 3 months or refrigerate up to 2 weeks.
notes: Can be eaten straight from the freezer. Fiber syrup is what gives the chewy texture — do not substitute.
